## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`, …) — enforced by CI
- [ ] Tested locally (`python3 -m http.server` or the Docker image) in a browser
- [ ] New/changed tools run entirely client-side — no network calls, no telemetry
- [ ] `data/tools.json` updated and still valid (CI checks this)
- [ ] No console errors when opening the changed tool(s)
- [ ] Screenshots attached for any visual change
